## Policy checklist

- [ ] I kept default behavior local-first and offline-by-default.
- [ ] I did not add telemetry, source-code upload, affiliate links, paid placement, or sponsored recommendations.
- [ ] I avoided legal conclusions such as compliant, non-compliant, legal, illegal, safe, or guaranteed.
- [ ] I used conservative wording for findings and recommendations.
- [ ] I disclosed any material conflict of interest relevant to vendor data, alternatives, scoring, or methodology.

## Evidence checklist

- [ ] Vendor, fingerprint, alternatives, or methodology claims are evidence-backed.
- [ ] Official sources are preferred; non-official sources are labelled.
- [ ] AI-assisted vendor profiles remain labelled `agent_draft` until human-reviewed.
- [ ] Verified status is used only for human-reviewed, evidence-backed claims.

## Security and privacy checklist

- [ ] No default network calls were added to scan paths.
- [ ] Sensitive files such as `.env`, private keys, certificates, and token files remain skipped by default.
- [ ] Reports and errors avoid printing secrets or raw sensitive content.
- [ ] Env template handling extracts keys only and avoids values.
